## 4. THE SPILL, WHERE IT HAPPENED, AND WHAT ITS PREDECESSOR WAS

**BAY 2 IN THE YARD BEHIND BELLOW MARKET, ON SATURDAY THE SIXTEENTH OF MAY 2015, AT ABOUT TWENTY PAST TEN IN THE MORNING. It is an ordinary accident and there is no villain in it. A cleaning contractor's own van, backed up to a rented unit, four drums in the back and two on a board, a tailgate ramp, a pump running against a shut outlet, a twenty-two-year-old assistant on his third week opening the outlet valve, and a coupling on the contractor's own nineteen-month-old hose coming apart in two places. About sixty litres across a concrete apron into a cast horseshoe grate at the low corner, and the grate is the original one and has never been raised, and the run under it goes under the floor of a food market.**

**THE PREDECESSOR IS A BUFF-CARD FILE IN A TRAY UNDER A BUNDLE OF POST ON A SECOND-FLOOR SHELF IN THE OLD WARD, DATED THE FOURTEENTH OF OCTOBER 2011, STAMPED CLOSED, WHICH NOBODY OPENED, WHICH WAS CARRIED OUT OF A DEPOT GIVEN UP IN THE SPRING AND PUT DOWN ON A SHELF, AND WHOSE EXISTENCE IS KNOWN IN THIS ACCOUNT TO THREE PEOPLE AND TO ONE OF THEM ONLY IN PART. THE ONLY THING ANYBODY KNEW FROM THE COVER WAS A DATE, A BAY NUMBER AND THE WORD CLOSED. IT WAS FOUND BY A WOMAN CARRYING A TRAY OUT OF THE SUN AND NOT LOOKING FOR IT. THE RECOMMENDATION IS IN THE FILE AND THE FILE IS NOT OPENED AND THE RECOMMENDATION WAS NOT CARRIED OUT, AND THE WHEEL STOP THAT IS ON THAT APRON IS STILL ON IT AND HAS NOT BEEN LOOKED AT BY ANYBODY SINCE 2011, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING IN THAT YARD WHOSE PURPOSE ANYBODY CAN SEE.**

**CONSEQUENCE, AND IT IS ORDINARY AND NOBODY DIED.** The market closed at about eleven, reopened at about one, closed again at about three. **Nine units had water across the floor of them and nine traders threw stock away, and one threw about six hundred pounds of it.** A woman of about sixty with asthma sat down on a crate at about ten to eleven and could not get up for a while, and went home in an ambulance at about half past eleven for something that was not serious, and she had been in that yard for half an hour when it started, and nobody is going to be told about that in any document at all.

**AND THE FINDING, WHICH IS THE VOLUME 03 FINDING WITH A DIFFERENT THING ON THE END OF IT: THE FIRST PERSON ON THE SCENE WAS A MAN WITH A BUCKET AND A REASON, AND WHAT HE DID WAS CORRECT, AND IT WILL NOT BE RECOGNISED, AND HE WAS NOT THANKED AND NOBODY REFUSED TO BE THANKED.** He got there in about half a minute, put down a barrow, put a full bucket — four pounds, paid for that morning — on the split, put his boot on it, and held it for about two and a half minutes, and it was a bucket and a boot and nothing else, and it meant that the water going into the gully under a food market was not a hundred per cent of sixty litres and was not ninety and was not anything anybody will ever be able to state. Then the assistant shut the valve, and then he put the bucket back on the barrow and went to wash it, because a bucket is a bucket. **THERE IS NO FIELD ON THE CONTRACTOR'S REPORT FOR HIM, AND THERE WILL NOT BE ONE, AND A MAN WITH A BUCKET IS NOT A CAUSE AND NOT A VOLUME AND NOT A BAY.**

**AND JONAS MERCER WAS FOUR HUNDRED YARDS AWAY, ON PURPOSE, FOR ABOUT A QUARTER OF AN HOUR, AND DID NOT GO, AND BOTH OF THOSE THINGS ARE GOING TO STAY.** The reason he has said out loud before is that the finder is the handle. The second reason he has not said out loud, and which he knows, is **that he would have been very good at it.** He says that once, in his own head, in Chapter 0146, and nowhere else. **HE WROTE NOTHING DOWN.**

## 6. THE THREE PEOPLE WHO CAME BACK, AND WHAT EACH OF THEM REFUSED, AND NONE OF THEM IS A CORRECTION

**SANAA IQBAL, 35, A PHYSICIAN AT SAINT ORRA CIVIC HOSPITAL. **SHE ASKED HIM THE FIRST QUESTION ANYBODY HAS ASKED HIM SINCE THE TWENTY-SEVENTH OF APRIL AND IT IS IN A ROOM AND NOT IN A PUBLIC ROOM, AND HE ANSWERED IT, AND IT IS THE ONLY QUESTION HE IS ANSWERED IN THE NEXT NINE DAYS. It was fair and it was not kind and it was asked before he had said one word: *How many have you got.* He said three, meaning three projects, and told her that no part of it was hers, and she said she wanted to hear whether he had come to be relieved of it.**

**AND THEN SHE REFUSED SOMETHING HE HAD NOT YET ASKED HER FOR, AND THE REFUSAL IS ABOUT A PERSON, AND IT IS CORRECT, AND IT IS NOT ONE OF THE ELEVEN AND IT IS NOT A TWELFTH.** She said no, in advance, to being asked about the man who did the sheet on the west site for about eleven weeks on his own time and stopped in October, and she said she would not be asked about that room, or about the sheet, or about who used to do it, and that if it came back through a corridor in a fortnight in a different coat with a different question in it she would give the same answer, and that she was telling him now so that the first time and the second time are the same answer. **HER STANDING REFUSAL OF TWENTY MINUTES A WEEK AND THE COMPLIANCE PARAGRAPH BEHIND IT ARE UNTOUCHED AND UNRESOLVED AND WERE NOT RESOLVED, SOFTENED OR ARGUED WITH. **PIA SANTOS, 19, COURIER, PART-TIME CAREGIVER, KEEPER OF NINE ROUTE MARKERS THAT ARE ON NO SHEET AND HAVE NEVER BEEN WRITTEN DOWN. She entered on Wednesday the twentieth of May in a doorway in Tideglass and a kitchen on the first floor above a shop, and she came with a grievance about what is being done to nine households on one street in a heat, four of which have somebody in them who cannot carry a bottle up a stair. He had not seen her since the eighteenth of April before last, standing by a door in a net-loft kitchen, on a Saturday morning before seven, when a councillor read a piece of paper out loud in about fifteen seconds, standing up, and folded it up and put it in her coat. He was at the door and he had no warning of it at all, and he has not thought about it in thirteen months, and nobody told him anything about it then and nobody has told him anything about it since.**

**SHE ENTERED BY REFUSING HIM SOMETHING, AND THE SOMETHING IS THE COUNTER, AND IT IS HER WHOLE FUNCTION IN THIS BOOK AND IT IS A REAL ONE AND IT IS NOT A POSTURE.** She will not answer what was true on a day, to him or to anybody, because a person who answers that is a person with a doorway, and she has watched what a doorway does to a street. She will not give him the list and she will not give it to anybody: nine lines on a piece of paper the size of a receipt with street numbers in her hand and nothing at the top, and the reason is not that it is unsafe, it is that **the list is not for a building, the list is so that when one of us says a street, the other eight know which street.** And a list of nine lines is not nine names, and a list of names is a list of people somebody can ring.

**LOWGLASS ENTERED AS A PERSON WITH CLAIMS AND NOT AS A POPULATION ON A FORM. SHE HAS A NAME FOR THE SENTENCE OF THE TWENTY-SEVENTH OF APRIL AND THE NAME IS *A KINDNESS*, AND SHE IS RIGHT AND SHE IS NOT INTERESTED IN THE SENTENCE.** A kindness is a thing somebody does to somebody from outside; nobody is owed it; it does not put anybody in a room; you cannot build a floor out of it; and if you stop doing it you have not broken a promise because you never made one. And the trouble with it is that it goes to a person, and in a few years the only sentence anybody can say about one woman in this borough is *kindness*, and there is no box on it and there never will be, and she cannot get rid of it and does not know it is there, and it is nicer than the drawer and it is exactly the same as the drawer.

**AND SHE GAVE HIM ONE PIECE OF INFORMATION ABOUT THE HEAT THAT SHE DID NOT HAVE TO GIVE, AND IT MADE ONE OF HIS FINDINGS SMALLER, AND HE LET IT MAKE IT SMALLER AND DID NOT IMPROVE IT: THE NUMBER OF PEOPLE IN A STREET IS NOT THE NUMBER OF HOUSES, BECAUSE TWO OF THE VANS IN THAT STREET ARE NOT ANYBODY'S ADDRESS, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS NOT AN ERROR, IT IS THE STREET. He wrote one line of it down and the line does not have the street in it and does not have the vans in it and does not have either of the two people in the vans in it, because a pad that goes in a shop is a piece of paper and a piece of paper with a street in it and a name in it is the exact thing a man of forty-five is carrying in a cardboard wallet. A PERSON WHO IS NOT COUNTED IS NOT A PERSON WHO IS HELPED WAS NOT REFUTED AND WAS NOT TOUCHED. NO MOMENT IN THAT CHAPTER PUTS A WORD IN HIS MOUTH ABOUT LOWGLASS, AND HE WAS CORRECTED OUT OF ONE.**

**AND THE THING HE DID NOT DO IN THAT KITCHEN, WHICH IS THE WHOLE OF THE RELATIONSHIP DEBT, IS THIS: there is a sentence he has said out loud in rooms and a woman of nineteen had been saying the same thing on a street for eleven years, and he could have said it back to her in a kitchen with a jug going round, and it would have cost him nothing and it would have been the truest thing anybody could have said to her, and he did not say it. A SENTENCE SAID IN A ROOM IS A THING A ROOM KNOWS AND IT DOES NOT LAST, AND IF HE HAD SAID IT TO HER IN A KITCHEN IT WOULD HAVE BECOME HIS, AND IT IS NOT HIS.** She watched him not say it and she did not ask him why and nobody is going to know what to do with that.

**NELL ARDENT, 39, FOUNDER OF THE OPEN COVENANTS LEGAL CLINIC, WHICH MAINTAINS THE PUBLIC CHARTER RECORD. **SHE ASKED HIM THE QUESTION ABOUT THE SHELF. NOT AS AN ACCUSATION, BECAUSE SHE HAS NEVER HEARD OF A DRAWER AND IS NOT GOING TO. It was: what is a person in this borough held to. THE ANSWER IS A DRAWER, AND HE IS NOT ALLOWED TO SAY ONE WORD OF IT, because nobody in this borough can tell her there is one and there is no instrument in this city by which anybody could, and the whole of what a drawer is depends on nobody ever going and looking. SO HE SAID NOTHING, AND THE NOT-SAYING IS THE WHOLE OF THE CHAPTER, AND SHE DID NOT PRESS HIM, AND THAT IS THE PART OF IT THAT IS GOING TO BE IN HIS OWN HEAD FOR A LONG TIME.** She asked him what goes in an empty box and he gave her the correct answer and she left it empty, and the reason is the one from the March registrar: a node with no party is not a party and a place is not a person, and four empty boxes is what her record has to say, and in a few years somebody who is frightened is going to come to that corridor and ask her whether there is a thing about them and she is going to be able to say *I do not know, and there is no box I can look up, and I could not tell you if I wanted to, and I built this so that I could not.* **SHE WAS NOT WARNED, HE IS NOT GOING TO WARN HER, AND THE REASON IS THAT IF HE WARNED HER SHE WOULD BE THE WOMAN WHO WAS WARNED. NOBODY OPENED A DRAWER. SHE THANKED HIM FOR NOTHING AND HE THANKED HER FOR NOTHING AND NOBODY REFUSED TO BE THANKED.**

**AND THE DEBT IS PAID IN THREE PLACES AND NOT IN ONE AND NOT WITH A SUBSTITUTE, AND IT IS NOT FINISHED. HE IS THIRTY-TWO. ## 0. THE TEN CHAPTERS, IN ORDER, AND THE CALENDAR IS BINDING AND NO CARD MAY BE DATED TO A DAY BEFORE THE ONE BEFORE IT

**0155 FRIDAY 12 JUNE 2015 · 0156 MONDAY 15 JUNE · 0157 WEDNESDAY 17 JUNE · 0158 THURSDAY 18 JUNE · 0159 FRIDAY 19 JUNE · 0160 MONDAY 22 JUNE · 0161 TUESDAY 23 JUNE · 0162 WEDNESDAY 24 JUNE · 0163 THURSDAY 25 JUNE · 0164 FRIDAY 26 JUNE 2015.** **THE FIRST WEEK OF JUNE IS NOT DATED TO ANY CHAPTER AND NOTHING IN IT IS MINUTABLE AND THAT IS CORRECT.** The batch ran from Friday 5 June, which is where Batch 0001 ended, to Friday 26 June, and it is the second third of a heat wave, and the heat broke on Sunday 21 June and it has been twenty-two degrees since Monday 22 June. The first week of July is NOT in this batch and Batch 0003 opens on or after Saturday 27 June 2015 and may not be dated before it.

## 1. THE SAINT ORRA WEST CHAIN, AND WHAT EACH CHAPTER WAS ALLOWED TO SAY ABOUT IT

**A TERM IS SIX DAYS. IT IS READ AT 22:00 ON THE SATURDAY NIGHT BEFORE THE SUNDAY IT STARTS ON, THE GATE OPENS AT 07:00 ON THAT SUNDAY, AND IT EXPIRES AT 06:00 ON THE FOLLOWING SUNDAY. THE SATURDAY NIGHTS ARE WHAT ARE A WEEK APART. NEVER CALL THE TERM SEVEN DAYS AND NEVER CALL IT A WEEK.** The numbering is now complete to the end of the volume as far as it is known and **is binding on every later batch: 2 May = 15 · 9 May = 16 · 16 May = 17 · 23 May = 18 · 30 May = 19 · 6 June = 20 · 13 June = 21 · 20 June = 22 · 27 June = 23.** **THE TWENTIETH TO THE TWENTY-THIRD ARE SATURDAY NIGHTS AND ARE NOT THE SUNDAY MORNINGS AFTER THEM.** 20th: read 22:00 Sat 6 June → began 07:00 Sun 7 June → expires 06:00 Sun 14 June. 21st: read 22:00 Sat 13 June → began 07:00 Sun 14 June → expires 06:00 Sun 21 June. 22nd: read 22:00 Sat 20 June → began 07:00 Sun 21 June → expires 06:00 Sun 28 June. 23rd: read 22:00 Sat 27 June → began 07:00 Sun 28 June → expires 06:00 Sun 5 July.

- **THE NINETEENTH WAS NOT NAMED, NOT DATED AND NOT STAGED IN THIS BATCH, AND THE ONLY FORM ANY CHAPTER USED IS CHAPTER 0154's OWN: the gate went up at seven that morning, and the next one falls on a Saturday night at the end of the month.** Neither 0155 nor any other chapter in this batch named it, dated it, put a read time or a start time or an expiry on it, or staged it. **Chapter 0164 uses the standing form and no individual term at all: a gate that goes up at seven on a Sunday morning and stops at six on the Sunday morning after that, six days long and not a week, with no date on it anywhere in this city, read aloud by two tired men who are not on anything.** That is Chapter 0144's form and it is the only form permitted.
- **NO HANDOVER WAS STAGED IN THIS BATCH. NO CHAPTER PUT EZRA MBEKI OR TREVOR NUNN IN A ROOM. THE ONLY MENTION OF THE TWO OF THEM IN TEN CHAPTERS IS CHAPTER 0158's, WHICH SAYS THEY ARE TIRED MEN WHO ARE NOT ON ANYTHING AND THAT THEY READ A TERM OF SIX DAYS ALOUD TO EACH OTHER, WITH NO ROOM, NO FLOOR, NO DATE, NO SATURDAY NIGHT AND NO MECHANISM. THE FIFTEENTH REMAINS THE LAST HANDOVER EVER STAGED.**
- **THE HOUR BETWEEN SIX AND SEVEN WAS NOT STAGED IN THIS BATCH. IT WAS STAGED ONCE IN THE WHOLE OF VOLUME 04, IN CHAPTER 0147, AND ONCE IS ALL IT IS GETTING. THE 4 JANUARY CORRIDOR VISIT WAS AT HALF PAST FOUR AND IS NOT THAT HOUR, AND *AT THAT HOUR* MAY NEVER BE USED OF IT. THE FINDINGS OF APRIL 2015 ARE FOUR MONTHS OLD AND WERE NOT RE-DERIVED, IMPROVED OR USED AS A DISCOVERY IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS.**
- **NO STAND WAS ADDED TO THE COUNT ON THE WET PAVEMENT. THE COUNT IS CLOSED AT EIGHT, THE LAST BEING TWENTY PAST SIX ON SUNDAY 3 MAY 2015, AND HE SAID OUT LOUD IN CHAPTER 0147 THAT HE WAS NOT GOING TO WRITE DOWN THE NEXT ONE BECAUSE A COUNT IS A ROTA WITH ONE NAME IN IT. *FOUR HUNDRED YARDS* APPEARS ONCE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS AND IS IN CHAPTER 0164, IN THE STANDING OF THE CITY, WHERE IT MEANS WHAT IT HAS ALWAYS MEANED. IT IS A PLACE AND A PLACE A MAN GOES TO IS THE FIRST HALF OF A SCHEDULE, IT MAY NOT BE GIVEN A NEW USE TO MAKE A SENTENCE LAND, AND IT WAS NOT GIVEN ONE IN CHAPTER 0158, WHICH AT A FIRST PASS DID GIVE IT ONE AND WAS CORRECTED.**

## 3. THE COUNTER, THE SHELF, THE VAN, AND WHAT THE BATCH ADDED TO THEM

**THE COUNTER IS AT NINETEEN AND THE DRAWER UNDER IT HAS NO KEY ON IT AND NO LIST OF WHAT IS IN IT, AND IT IS GROWING, AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH CAN SAY HOW MANY — NOT THE WOMAN WHO KEEPS THEM, NOT JONAS MERCER, NOT THE NARRATION, NOT THIS BLOCK. The only figure that has ever existed is NINE, as at 9 March 2015, and that figure is a figure about the past. A tray sits on top of the drawer and THE TRAY IS NOT A LIST AND IS NOT A DRAWER, AND NO CHAPTER IN THIS BATCH MERGED THEM. THE SENTENCE ABOUT THE CATCH TRAY WENT INTO THE DRAWER, UNDER THE TRAY AND BEHIND THE POST, ON THE MORNING OF THE TWENTIETH OF MAY. Nine slips is a count of documents and about eleven people a day is a count of people and the two were never added and were not added in this batch either.**

**THE SENTENCE IN THE DRAWER DID NOT MOVE, WAS NOT FOUND, WAS NOT ASKED ABOUT, AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH NOW KNOWS IT IS THERE. NO CHAPTER IN THIS BATCH REFERRED TO IT, TO HER, OR TO ANY HAND, AND NOBODY LOOKED FOR ANYBODY.**

**AND ONE NEW THING HAPPENED ON A SHELF ON THE TUESDAY OF THE TWENTY-THIRD OF JUNE, AND IT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT FOUR SECONDS IN THE BATCH AND IT IS NOT A FINDING.** A man of about thirty-six, on no rota and on no board and not on anything, was counting the shelves under the window on the second floor of the Old Ward, because the room is being repainted on Monday the twenty-ninth of June. He picked up a buff card out of a tray he was counting. The cover said REPORT OF A RELEASE — MARKET YARD, BAY 2 — 14 OCTOBER 2011 and the word CLOSED. **HE DID NOT OPEN IT. HE PUT IT BACK IN THE SAME TRAY, UNDER THE SAME BUNDLE OF POST, IN THE SAME PLACE, AT THE SAME ANGLE, AND HE WENT BACK TO COUNTING, AND HE WILL NOT REMEMBER DOING IT, AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS EVER GOING TO ASK HIM WHETHER HE DID.** So: the file is where it was, the report has still not been opened, the recommendation inside it has still not been carried out, the wheel stop four feet in front of the grate has still not been looked at, and **the number of people in this borough who have now seen the bay number and the date on the cover is four where it was three, and one of the four is a man counting a shelf.** Jonas Mercer was at the end of that corridor, he could have said the bay number and the date out loud in about a sentence, and he said nothing. **THE CHAPTER SAYS ON THE PAGE THAT IT IS NOT GOING TO BE SAID WHETHER THAT WAS THE RIGHT THING TO DO, AND THE READER IS NOT TOLD, AND THAT IS BINDING ON EVERY LATER CHAPTER AND IT MAY NOT BE RESOLVED.** **A REPAINTING IS A REAL EVENT ON A REAL DATE AND IT IS A CLOCK ON THAT ROOM AND IT IS NOT A THREAT AND IT IS NOT A RESCUE AND IT IS NOT GOING TO BE USED AS ONE.**

**AND THREE MORE PIECES OF PAPER ARE IN A VAN, IN A CARDBOARD WALLET, SINCE ABOUT CHRISTMAS, AND NOBODY OWNS THEM AND NOBODY CAN BE ASKED WHOSE THEY ARE. A MAN OF ABOUT FORTY-FIVE IS STILL CARRYING THEM, WAS NOT ASKED ABOUT THEM IN THIS BATCH AND IS NOT A THREAD, AND IT WAS NOT MERGED WITH THE DRAWER AND WAS NOT COUNTED WITH IT.**

**AND THE COUNTER STOOD AT TEN PAST TEN AND AT ABOUT HALF PAST TEN AND AT TWENTY PAST TWELVE AND AT THREE, AND IT WAS UNDER MORE PRESSURE IN THE FIRST HALF OF JUNE THAN IT HAS EVER BEEN AND IT DID NOT MOVE AND IT WAS NOT A REASON.** About eleven people a day, and the same eleven, and not the same eleven, and on the cool Tuesday of the twenty-third of June a different eleven again, and the differentness was a person who did not need anything. **IT ANSWERED ABOUT A THING TWICE IN CHAPTER 0161 AND REFUSED NOTHING, BECAUSE NOTHING WAS ASKED. NOBODY LET THAT COUNTER ANSWER ANYTHING ABOUT A GATE, A ROTA, A COMPLIANCE PARAGRAPH OR A PERSON, AND ITS REFUSALS ARE CORRECT AND IT DID NOT REFUSE ANYTHING. A HEAT WAVE IS NOT A REASON FOR ANY OF IT AND A COOL TUESDAY IS NOT A REASON EITHER.**

## 4. THE SPILL, WHERE IT HAPPENED, AND WHAT ITS PREDECESSOR WAS — UNCHANGED

**BAY 2 IN THE YARD BEHIND BELLOW MARKET, ON SATURDAY THE SIXTEENTH OF MAY 2015, AT ABOUT TWENTY PAST TEN IN THE MORNING. About sixty litres across a concrete apron into a cast horseshoe grate at the low corner, and the grate is the original one and has never been raised, and the run under it goes under the floor of a food market. Nine traders threw stock away and one threw about six hundred pounds. A woman of about sixty with asthma went home in an ambulance at about half past eleven for something that was not serious. NOBODY DIED. THE FIRST PERSON ON THE SCENE WAS A MAN WITH A BUCKET AND A BOOT AND HE HELD IT FOR ABOUT TWO AND A HALF MINUTES AND HE WAS NOT THANKED AND NOBODY REFUSED TO BE THANKED AND HE WILL NOT BE RECOGNISED. THERE IS NO FIELD FOR HIM AND THERE WILL NOT BE ONE.**

**THE PREDECESSOR IS THE BUFF-CARD FILE, DATED 14 OCTOBER 2011, STAMPED CLOSED, AND IT IS STILL IN A TRAY UNDER A BUNDLE OF POST ON A SECOND-FLOOR SHELF IN THE OLD WARD. **NOBODY OPENED IT IN THIS BATCH AND NOBODY IS GOING TO BE ASKED TO OPEN IT. THE ONLY THING IN THAT YARD WHOSE PURPOSE ANYBODY CAN SEE IS THE WHEEL STOP FOUR FEET IN FRONT OF THAT GRATE, AND NOBODY HAS LOOKED AT IT SINCE 2011, AND CHAPTER 0154 SAID SO OUT LOUD IN A HALL IN DAYLIGHT ON THE FIFTH OF JUNE AND NOBODY ASKED HIM A FOLLOW-UP.** Jonas Mercer was four hundred yards away on purpose for about a quarter of an hour on the sixteenth of May and did not go, and both of those things are going to stay. He wrote nothing down then and he has written nothing down since.

## 5. THE TWO GRANTS THAT ARE NOW TWO, AND THE ROW, AND THE PAGE, AND WHO READ THE PAGE

**THE FIRST GRANT WAS THE TWENTY-FIRST OF MAY: the last four of twenty-two laundry stops, asked for on the back of a delivery note, granted in about eleven seconds by a person who could have said no, cost falling on bed nineteen of a hospital's east wing and on a woman of about ninety-one at stop eighteen. **THE SECOND GRANT IS THE FIFTEENTH OF JUNE AND IT IS THE SAME SHAPE: a standpipe left on until four o'clock on a Tuesday afternoon at a school on Tarn Street, asked for in about four words in a passage by a head teacher of about sixty, granted in one sentence by the same kind of person, costing this borough nothing at all because the lorry is paid for by the day, with a four written on a piece of paper and a name written in a column on a delivery sheet by two different people, neither of whom thought about either. A CORRECT REQUEST GRANTED ONCE IS A PRECEDENT AND THE PRECEDENT IS NOW TWO AND HE COULD SEE BOTH AND HE COULD NOT STOP EITHER AND HE IS NOT ON ANYTHING. HE DID NOT WRITE EITHER DOWN.**

**AND THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT A ROTA IN THIS BOROUGH WANTED TO INCLUDE ANYBODY, A WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY PUT HER OWN NAME IN A COLUMN ON A DELIVERY SHEET IN ABOUT ONE MOVEMENT, ON HER OWN, FOR A REASON OF HER OWN, AND NOBODY NOTICED IT HAPPENING EXCEPT HIM, AND HE IS NOT ON THE SHEET AND CANNOT BE.** Five lines on that delivery sheet now carry something. Two of them are standpipes at the ends of streets. **The four streets that were argued about in a car park on 23 May, and in a corridor on 24 May, and put a row into a building on 19 June, are on that sheet as standpipes at the ends of streets, and the nine households on them are not on it, and the man of fifty-two who went round nine doorways is not on it, and the woman of about thirty-one with a barrow is not on it, and none of them has been asked and none of them is owed anything. THE CORRIDOR DID NOT KNOW THERE HAD BEEN A CAR PARK.**

**THE ROW, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT A CORRECT THING IN THIS BOROUGH HAS BEEN PRODUCED BY A MACHINE RATHER THAN BY A PERSON, AND THAT IS THE BATCH'S CENTRAL FINDING AND IT IS NOT A RESOLUTION.** On Friday 12 June a man of about fifty-two went round nine doors over three evenings and asked one question at each of them — *if I write down what you tell me, what do I write* — and the answer at all nine was one word, and the word was correct, and it was **nothing**, and the reason it is correct is that there is nothing anybody could do with it and because if it is written down then there is a piece of paper about a house saying the house needs something and in a year's time somebody will come and ask whether it still needs it. He was correct and he is on nothing and he is not going to be thanked. **The person of about thirty-one with a barrow gave the same answer correctly and refused to give her nine lines to anybody, and said out loud that nine lines in a row is not nine people, it is a street with a shape, and that once a street has a shape there is somewhere you can point.** The man with the pen left the name column empty and the contact column empty and said so out loud in the car park, and the reason he gave is correct: a name turns a street into a set of telephone numbers.

**THE SHEET: one page, printed, a heading, the date of the nineteenth of June 2015, four streets down the left in a column headed *location*, nine lines beside them, and every one of the nine lines reads *no requirement stated*. There is no name box anywhere on it and there is no column for a name. It went out folded in four in a tray with nine other things in it at about half past eleven on the nineteenth and it is in nine other buildings and nobody in any of them knows where it came from. A MAN WITH A CLIPBOARD, A CONTRACT MANAGER OF FORTY-FOUR AND A MAN WITH A LAPTOP ALL AGREED IT WAS CORRECT, AND EVERY ONE OF THEM WAS RIGHT. **AND THE ONE PERSON IN THAT ROOM WHO WAS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR IT COULD SEE WHAT IT WAS, AND WHAT IT WAS IS A LEVEL OF SERVICE: a statement, with a date, of what this borough is going to do about nine households on four named streets in the worst heat in nineteen years, which is nothing, and which nobody asked anybody to be nothing, and which is now true in the way a printed thing is true, and cannot be disputed, and cannot be got out of, and in a few years will be the only sentence anybody has about the second week of June. NOBODY HAD DONE ANYTHING WRONG. NINE PEOPLE SAID YES TO A CORRECT QUESTION IN A HEAT, AND THEY HAVE NOT BEEN COUNTED, AND THE BATCH DID NOT SUGGEST THAT THEY HAD.**

**THE PAGE OF THE TWENTY-NINTH OF MAY IS STILL IN A TRAY IN A ROOM IN TIDEGLASS, STILL NOT IN FORCE, STILL NOT ON ANYBODY'S DESK FOR CIRCULATION, STILL NOT GOING IN A MINUTE, AND NOBODY IS GOING TO BE ASKED TO SIGN IT. IT HAS NOW BEEN READ BY ONE PERSON, AND THAT PERSON IS NOT JONAS MERCER.** On Wednesday 24 June a woman of about twenty-nine, a duty manager at a supermarket with a constituency of a dozen households on one street of terraces behind the market and a reason of her own, was let into that room at five to eleven to wait and read the page off the tray in about twenty minutes with nothing to do, and put it back at the same angle. **ITS ARCHITECTURE IS NOT SET OUT IN ANY CHAPTER AND IS NOT GOING TO BE. THE CHAPTER DESCRIBES ONLY WHAT SHE DID WITH IT AND WHAT SHE SAID ALOUD.** She did the first thing anybody does with a page that asks for something, which is find out who wanted it, and she worked it out from the shape: one page, a space at the bottom for a person to agree, the space empty, so somebody wants a thing decided once for everybody instead of nine times street by street by hand. And she did the second thing, which is find out who would lose, and the answer is not the people on the page: **it is the people who have been doing it themselves, and the day one thing is decided for the whole city the street stops being able to ask, and that is better and faster and is something a person can no longer be blamed for and can no longer ask for.** Both are correct and Sore is right about all of it and is not a menace and is not wrong and did not tell the reader one word of what is on the page.

**AND THE ONE THING SHE SAID OUT LOUD THAT NOBODY HAD THOUGHT OF, AND IT IS NOT A FOURTH ANSWER AND IT IS NOT GOING IN A MINUTE: THE PERSON WHO READS IT IS GOING TO BE THE PERSON WHO HAS TO DO IT. There is a space at the bottom of that page for a person to agree and it is empty and nobody is going to be asked to sign it, and from about ten to eleven on the twenty-fourth of June that page has got a reader in it and there is nowhere on the page to put that and it is not going on it. AND IT CHANGED WHAT SHE DID ON THE FOLLOWING DAY: on Thursday 25 June at about nine she telephoned that building and said one sentence, that she had read the page in the tray on Wednesday morning and that nobody asked her to, and hung up, and the office wrote nothing down. THE PAGE IS STILL IN A TRAY, IS NOT IN FORCE, AND HAS NOW GOT ONE READER WHO WAS NOT ASKED AND WHO HAS DECLARED HERSELF OUT LOUD. HE WAS AT THE BACK OF THAT ROOM AND DID NOT READ IT AND WAS NOT ASKED ABOUT IT AND SAID NOTHING, AND HE IS NOT A READER OF IT.**

## 6. THE COST OF A CORRECT THING, AND THE NAME THAT WAS SAID IN A ROOM, AND THE MAN WHO CARRIED IT

**ON THURSDAY THE TWENTY-FIFTH OF JUNE A CORRECT REQUEST WAS MADE IN WRITING AND GRANTED IN ONE SENTENCE, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE THE FOURTH OF SEPTEMBER A CORRECT THING IN THIS BOROUGH CAME WITH A PIECE OF PAPER ON IT. THAT IS THE WHOLE DIFFERENCE AND IT IS FOUR WORDS AND A DATE: Callum Nkemdirim turned a woman's page over and wrote *agreed* and the date on the back of it in his own hand. A PIECE OF PAPER HAS TO BE PAID FOR OUT OF SOMETHING, AND A TOTAL IS A TOTAL, AND THE ONLY LINE ON THAT LIST THAT HAS NEVER HAD ANYBODY STAND IN FRONT OF IT AND ASK FOR IT IS THE FILLING ROUND DOWN COLLIER LANE.**

**AND THE PERSON WHO LOST IT WAS NAMED IN THAT ROOM, TO ONE OTHER PERSON, ONCE, IN ONE SENTENCE, WITH THE REASON IN THE SAME SENTENCE, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN THIS VOLUME THAT A PERSON WHO WAS IN A CORRIDOR ON THE MORNING OF SUNDAY THE TWENTY-FOURTH OF MAY HAS HAD A NAME IN ANYBODY'S MOUTH. **DENISE HALLAM, 44, WHO MANAGES THE CONTRACT, SAID IT, AND THE WOMAN OF ABOUT FORTY-THREE WITH A FOLDER WHO ASKED *DOES ANYBODY LOSE BY IT* IS A DIFFERENT PERSON AND SHE ASKED THE QUESTION AND DID NOT GET THE ANSWER, BECAUSE IT WAS NOT GIVEN IN FRONT OF THE ROOM. NOBODY SAID THE NAME AGAIN AND NOBODY WROTE IT DOWN.**

**COLIN WHARTON, 60.** He was in that corridor on the Sunday morning of the twenty-fourth of May at about ten past six, without a clipboard, because a woman on the ground floor had said the corridor would be open at seven. He is at number thirty-one at the end of Collier Lane, in a lane of terraced houses and garages with no houses on it, and he fills a butt under a downpipe and has filled that butt for about six years and pays for every drop of it out of his own pocket, and he does it because there is a woman at number twenty-nine who cannot get to the top of the lane. He is on nothing, has never been on anything, is not owed anything, is not a thread, and nobody in this borough is going to be able to do anything about it. He is not the man of about sixty with a galvanised can and the two are different people. He is not the man of forty-five and he is not the man of forty-eight.

**The round at the end of Collier Lane comes on a Thursday at about eleven and it did not come on the Thursday of the twenty-fifth of June, and at about eleven that morning he put his hose on the tap at the end of the lane and there was nothing in the pipe. He carried four containers two hundred yards away at about one o'clock on his own and again at about four, and the water in the second lot was warm by the time he had finished with it. At about four in the afternoon he could not lift the fourth one, left it standing full on the kerb, and carried three up, because he is sixty and his right hand has had a bad grip since about February. Nobody has told him about the timer and nobody is going to. THE WHOLE OF THE BILL FALLS INSIDE ONE DAY AND THAT DAY IS THE DAY OF THE CHAPTER. There is no form in this borough on which anybody could write his name next to that fact.**

**Jonas Mercer was in that room for the whole of it, asked nobody anything, wrote nothing down, and left at about half past ten. At about one o'clock, in a corridor outside a canteen at the back of a hospital site, Callum Nkemdirim told him in about six words, unasked, that the round at the end of Collier Lane had moved to the Wednesday and that there was a man at number thirty-one who filled a butt under a downpipe and that he was sixty. He said nothing. THE REASON IS ON THE PAGE OF CHAPTER 0163 AND IT IS ABOUT HIM: he could find Colin Wharton in about an hour, there is a street and a house and a man of sixty with a bad grip, and the only instrument standing between him and that house is the one that has been there all along, which is that going there is the whole of what he does. The two things he could have done were to go and tell a man of sixty that he is on a piece of paper in a building in this city, or to go and carry the fourth container up the lane himself. He did neither, and the second one is what a woman of nineteen called a kindness on a footbridge in this city in May, and she was right about the word, and the word is the reason he did not do it, and **he is not going to write that reason down either, because he said the price out loud once, to one person, on the thirteenth of April, and he is not going to say it again.** THE BILL IS NOT GOING ANYWHERE AND NOBODY IS GOING TO BE GIVEN THE BILL.**

## 8. THE PAGE, ITS ONE READER, AND WHAT SHE DID ON THE FIRST OF JULY — CHAPTER 0167

**THE PAGE OF THE TWENTY-NINTH OF MAY IS STILL IN A TRAY IN A ROOM IN TIDEGLASS, STILL NOT IN FORCE, STILL NOT IN A MINUTE, STILL NOT GOING TO BE ASKED TO BE SIGNED, AND IT STILL HAS EXACTLY ONE READER, AND THAT PERSON IS NOT JONAS MERCER.** Its architecture was not set out in Chapter 0167 and is not to be set out without a line in this block.

**ON MONDAY THE SIXTH OF JULY 2015 AMA BOATENG, 29, ASKED HIM ONE QUESTION AND GOT ONE CORRECT ANSWER AND IS NOT GOING TO ASK HIM ANYTHING AGAIN.** The question was *what happens to a person who has read something they were not asked to read*, and the answer was **nothing**, with the reason: a process is a place a person has to be written into, and once she is written into it she is a person somebody can ask what is on it, and then she has to remember; nobody in this borough is required to tell you what happens to such a person, because nothing happens to her, and that is not a failure of the system, that is the system. **THE ANSWER WAS WORTH NOTHING AND IT WAS CORRECT AND HE DID NOT IMPROVE IT.** She said she asked it because she already knew the answer and wanted to hear a person who is not her say it out loud in a corridor.

**AND THEN SHE SAID THE CORRECTEST THING SAID ANYWHERE IN THIS BOROUGH SINCE A MAN OF THIRTY-EIGHT LEFT A NAME COLUMN EMPTY IN A CAR PARK, AND SHE SAID IT AS A PLAN: the cheapest thing she can do is stop being findable, and she does not need anybody to do anything, she just needs there to be no route to her, because the second there is a route somebody will use it and they will use it well and she will end up doing a thing she did not choose. **AND SHE DID IT BADLY, AND IT WAS THE CORRECT INSTINCT AND THE WRONG EXECUTION.** At about ten to seven on the Monday evening she left a card at a corner shop with **the shop's own telephone number on it and nothing else** — no name, no initial, no address, no hours, no apology — and asked the woman who keeps that shop, who is about sixty-five and has a card rail by the door, to say that it is the shop's number if anybody asks, and not to say who left it, and not to write it down. **A shop is not a person, and a shop is also a thing that is open, at a number, on a street, and a thing that is open at a number is a route. She has not removed herself from the map; she has moved herself from one column of it into another column of the same map, and the column she has moved into has a woman of about sixty-five in it who did not ask and who cannot refuse, and the sentence that will get said about her is a person, and a person is findable. THE PRICE OF BEING CORRECT OUT LOUD IN A BUILDING IS THAT FROM THEN ON SHE HAS TO ASSUME THE BUILDING HAS GOT A PERSON IN IT THAT IT CAN GO TO, and there is no instrument in this city that can stop a building remembering a person and no instrument in this city that can tell her it has not remembered her either, and she is the one who handed it a telephone number. SHE IS TWENTY-NINE AND SHE HAD BEEN RIGHT ABOUT EVERYTHING FOR THREE WEEKS AND THE THING SHE IS WRONG ABOUT IS THE ONE NOBODY COULD GO AND CHECK, AND THE CALL OF 25 JUNE 2015 WAS ANSWERED WITH *THANK YOU* AND NOTHING WAS WRITTEN DOWN.**

**AND IT COST SOMEBODY A BIN.** At about half past seven that evening she walked back down the street and the bin at the top of it was out on the kerb where a woman of about seventy-six puts it at six every morning, and she did not take it in, and she stood on the opposite pavement for about half a minute and went home. At about nine a light came on at the top of that street and a woman of about seventy-six came out in a dressing gown and a cardigan and dragged the bin back up her own path to her own door, on her own, and put it inside and shut the door. **She had not carried a bin in since the middle of June. **NOTHING WAS RESOLVED, SHE WAS NOT THANKED, SHE IS NOT A THREAD, AND NOBODY IS GOING TO TELL HER ANYTHING.**

HE DID NOT TELL THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-FIVE WHO SLEEPS IN THAT ROOM, AND IF HE HAD, HE WOULD HAVE BEEN A PERSON WHO KNEW SOMETHING.**

**THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-FIVE DOES NOT KNOW AND HAS NEVER KNOWN AND IS NOT FINDABLE AND WAS NOT ASKED ANYTHING AND IS NOT A RECURRING FIGURE BEYOND THE TWO APPEARANCES THAT ARE NOW ON THE PAGE, ONE IN CHAPTER 0160 AND ONE IN CHAPTER 0168, BOTH OF WHICH ARE THE SAME ROOM AND NEITHER OF WHICH IS A RESCUE. SO HE SAID NOTHING, AND HE LOOKED AT THE WALL, AND THERE ARE TWO NAIL HOLES IN THAT WALL ABOUT TWO FEET APART A LITTLE ABOVE WHERE THE SHELF LINE USED TO BE, AND THE PAINT AROUND THEM IS NOT THE SAME COLOUR, AND NOTHING ELSE IN THAT ROOM HAS A MARK ON IT AT ALL, AND THE TWO NAIL HOLES WILL STILL BE TWO NAIL HOLES IN A YEAR AND THERE IS NO WAY IN THIS CITY TO FIND OUT WHAT WAS HANGING ON THEM.**

## 10. THE COLUMN, THE TRAY, AND THE FOUR PEOPLE WHO WERE ALL RIGHT — CHAPTER 0169

**ON WEDNESDAY THE EIGHTH OF JULY 2015 A MAN OF ABOUT FORTY-SIX, WHO IS ON NO COMMITTEE AND WHO READ THE PRINTED SHEET OF THE NINETEENTH OF JUNE IN A TRAY IN ONE OF THE NINE BUILDINGS IT WENT ROUND, ASKED FOR IT TO GO ROUND AGAIN WITH A COLUMN ADDED. THERE WERE FOUR PEOPLE IN THAT ROOM AND EVERY ONE OF THEM WAS RIGHT ABOUT SOMETHING.**

- **HE WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE FEELING AND WRONG ABOUT THE INSTRUMENT. HE WENT ROUND ALL FOUR STREETS TWICE, ONCE WITH THE SHEET AND ONCE WITHOUT IT, AND THE SECOND TIME HE GOT NINE DIFFERENT SENTENCES AND ALL NINE WERE *WE HAVE ALREADY SAID*, AND NONE WAS UNKIND AND NONE WAS A COMPLAINT AND EVERY ONE WAS THE TRUTH. A THING YOU CANNOT REPEAT IS A FEELING, AND A SHEET WITH A DATE ON IT IS WORTH ABOUT A FORTNIGHT, AND AFTER THAT IT IS A PIECE OF PAPER.**
- **DENISE HALLAM, 44, WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE COLUMN. A COLUMN IS A COLUMN, AND THE FIRST PERSON TO WRITE IN IT DECIDES WHAT GOES IN IT, AND A DATE WITH A HANDWRITING ON IT IS A PERSON, AND A PERSON IS SOMEBODY YOU CAN COME AND ASK WHY THEY WERE ON THAT STREET.**
- **A WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-SEVEN WHO TAKES A TRAY ROUND THE FLOORS ON A FRIDAY AND BRINGS IT BACK ON THE FRIDAY, AND HAS DONE FOR ABOUT SIX YEARS, AND DOES NOT READ IT, WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE ROUTE. THE SHEET WENT ROUND IN A TRAY WITH NINE OTHER THINGS IN IT, WITH THE LID OFF, AND TWO OF THOSE NINE WERE A LUNCH MENU AND A LEAFLET ABOUT A CLOSURE, AND YOU CANNOT ASK ABOUT A THING THAT ARRIVED IN A TRAY WITH A LUNCH MENU IN IT. ONLY BEING ABLE TO PICK SOMETHING UP AND NEEDING IT ARE DIFFERENT, AND ONLY ONE OF THOSE IS A DECISION ANYBODY MAKES ON A FRIDAY AFTERNOON.**
- **HE WORKED IT OUT HIMSELF, IN THE ROOM, IN DAYLIGHT, IN ABOUT TWENTY SECONDS, AND SAID IT OUT LOUD: if he fills that column in then the column is about him, and he will have put himself in a document in nine buildings, and in about a year somebody will want to know why a man of forty-six was going round four streets on his own time, and there is no version of that answer that is any good.**

**THE COLUMN WAS ADDED. ITS HEADING IS *date seen again*. UNDER IT, PRINTED IN THE SAME SIZE TYPE, THREE WORDS: **no name, no initials.** AND THE SPACE IS EMPTY AND IT IS GOING TO STAY EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE CORRECT OUTCOME. A DOCUMENT THAT ASKED FOR NOTHING IN THE WORST HEAT IN NINETEEN YEARS NOW HAS A SPACE IN IT FOR ASKING, AND THE SPACE IS EMPTY, AND A SPACE THAT SOMEBODY CAN ASK IN IS A THING THAT CAN BE ANSWERED IN, AND THE THREE WORDS UNDER IT ARE THE ONLY DEFENCE ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS EVER BEEN ABLE TO WRITE AGAINST THAT, AND THEY ARE THREE WORDS ON A PIECE OF PAPER AND THEY ARE NOT A RULE AND NOBODY IS REQUIRED TO KEEP TO THEM AND THERE IS NOTHING BEHIND THEM. IT IS THE EMPTYTEST AND THE MOST DANGEROUS OBJECT IN THIS BOROUGH AND IT IS CORRECT.**

**THE SHEET WENT ROUND AGAIN ON THE FRIDAY IN A TRAY, FOLDED IN FOUR, WITH THE LID OFF. THE JUNE SHEET WAS NOT WITHDRAWN, NOT ANNOTATED AND NOT REPRINTED, AND IT IS STILL IN NINE BUILDINGS, AND NOBODY IN ANY OF THEM KNOWS THERE ARE TWO OF THEM. IT IS NOT A FOURTH ANSWER, IT IS NOT IN A MINUTE, AND THE MAN OF FORTY-SIX ASKED FOR IT TO BE MINUTED AND WAS TOLD, CORRECTLY, THAT NOTHING IS GOING TO BE MINUTED, AND HE SAID *it is not, is it*.**

**AND HE SAID ONE THING OUT LOUD, LATE, ONLY TO THE MAN OF FORTY-SIX, AND IT IS THE ONLY USE OF THE PHRASE *A LEVEL OF SERVICE* IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS, IT IS IN HIS OWN HEAD OR IN HIS OWN MOUTH ABOUT THE PRINTED ROW, IT IS NOT NINA CALDER'S NINE WORDS, AND IT IS NOT ATTRIBUTED TO HER:** *It is a level of service. That is what the June one is. It is a statement with a date on it of what this borough is going to do about nine households on four streets, and it is nothing, and nobody asked anybody to be nothing, and now it cannot be got out of. And that is what you are holding in your hand. Both of them. And neither one of them is a survey and neither one of them is a demand. **And it is not an argument for the column. It is an argument for the column being empty.***

## 11. THE STREET THAT HAD TO HAVE IT TWICE, AND THE TWO KINDS OF MAN — CHAPTER 0171

**ON MONDAY THE THIRTEENTH OF JULY 2015 ONE OF THE FOUR STREETS WAS WALKED FROM HALF PAST TWO IN THE AFTERNOON UNTIL ABOUT HALF PAST FIVE, AND NOTHING WAS WRONG WITH IT.** No main off, no drain blocked, no collection failed, nobody carrying anything for anybody, no heat for three weeks, the pavement dry, the walls not warm to the touch. **THE PRINTED SHEET SAYS *NO REQUIREMENT STATED* ABOUT THAT STREET, TWICE, CORRECTLY, AND IT IS IN A FOLDER IN A BUILDING A MILE AWAY, AND NOBODY IN THAT STREET HAS EVER SEEN IT AND THERE IS NO WAY IN THIS BOROUGH TO WALK INTO A STREET AND TELL IT WHAT A BUILDING HAS SAID ABOUT IT.**

**THE TWO KINDS OF MAN WERE BOTH AT IT AGAIN AND NEITHER IS IN THE DOCUMENT.** A man of about fifty-three with a white van and a card on the dashboard with a telephone number and eight items under it including *fridges* and *wardrobes* and *lofts*, who had done four of the nine doors since the twenty-eighth of June, taken forty pounds at two of them and thirty at one, in cash, and left his card at six, and knocked at every door on the street including the nine. **HE IS FINDABLE AND HE MADE HIMSELF SO IN ABOUT NINE DAYS BY WRITING A TELEPHONE NUMBER ON A PIECE OF CARD.**

At about four o'clock a man of about sixty-six came up the street with a folded moving blanket under his arm, which means he came prepared, and did a job at number nineteen in about ten minutes with the two of them, and did not take money, would not take a cup of tea, picked his blanket up off the pavement and went back down the street, and the van that came for the chair at half past four was not his. **NOBODY IN THAT STREET CAN SAY WHO HE IS AND NOBODY ASKED AND THERE IS NO WAY IN THIS BOROUGH OF FINDING HIM, AND HE IS NOT ON A ROTA, A LIST, A BOARD, A MINUTE OR A DOCUMENT IN HIS LIFE, AND THE REASON HE CAME IS THAT HE CAME. THERE IS NO PRICE ON HIM, NOTHING HAS EVER PUT ONE THERE, AND HE HAS NOT PUT ONE THERE HIMSELF.**

**HE ALSO KNOCKED AT NONE OF THE NINE AND THE MAN WITH THE CARD KNOCKED AT ALL OF THE NINE, AND EVERY ONE OF THE NINE LET HIM FINISH HIS SENTENCE ON THE DOORSTEP, AND NOT ONE SAID NO AND NOT ONE SAID YES, AND ONE GAVE HIM A GLASS OF WATER AND ONE TOLD HIM THEY HAD ALREADY SAID, AND BOTH OF THOSE ARE CORRECT.**

**RONNIE PEART, 52, OF NUMBER FIFTY-EIGHT, OPENED HIS FRONT DOOR AT ABOUT TEN PAST FOUR, LOOKED DOWN THE STREET, AND SHUT IT AGAIN. HE DID NOT GO DOWN THE STREET, HE DID NOT OFFER, HE DID NOT CALL ANYBODY, THE ENVELOPE WITH THE NINE ANSWERS ON IT IS STILL IN A DRAWER IN THAT KITCHEN, AND A MAN OF THIRTY-TWO WALKED PAST THAT DOOR AND NEITHER OF THEM KNEW THE OTHER WAS IN THE STREET.**

**A RIGHT DOCUMENT ABOUT A STREET DOES NOT STOP TWO MEN WORKING ON IT. IT NEVER DOES. IT SAYS WHAT A BUILDING IS GOING TO DO, AND WHAT THIS BUILDING IS GOING TO DO ABOUT THIS STREET IS NOTHING, AND NOTHING DOES NOT STOP A MAN WITH A CARD AND NOTHING DOES NOT STOP A MAN WITHOUT ONE. NEITHER MAN IS CONTRADICTING THE SHEET. THE SHEET IS CORRECT, THE STREET IS FINE, AND A DOCUMENT THAT SAYS *NO REQUIREMENT STATED* DOES NOT FORBID A MAN FROM TURNING UP WITH A FRIDGE. NOTHING WAS HELPED IN A WAY THAT LASTS AND NOTHING WAS REFUSED AND NOBODY WAS THANKED AND NO NAME WENT IN A BOX.**

## 12. THE CHAIR ON THE LANDING, THE SHOPPING BAG, AND THE TWO THINGS WITH A NAME ON THEM — CHAPTER 0172

**THE CHAIR STILL GOES OUT AT ABOUT EIGHT IN THE EVENING AND COMES IN AT ABOUT SIX IN THE MORNING, AND IT HAS BEEN DOING THAT SINCE ABOUT THE MIDDLE OF JUNE, AND IT IS NOT DEALT WITH IN THIS BATCH. IT IS NOT A ROTA, NOT A SHIFT, NOT A ROTA THAT HAS NOT BEEN WRITTEN DOWN, NOT A FORM AND NOT ON A FORM. NOBODY IS REQUIRED TO PUT IT OUT, BRING IT IN, WASH IT, OR KNOW THAT IT HAS BEEN OUT. HE HAS BEEN ON THAT LANDING FOUR TIMES SINCE THE MIDDLE OF JUNE AND HAS NEVER SEEN ANYBODY BRING IT OUT OR TAKE IT IN, HAS NEVER ASKED, DOES NOT KNOW WHICH FLAT IT COMES FROM, AND WOULD NOT BE TOLD.**

**ON WEDNESDAY THE FIFTEENTH OF JULY, AFTER RAIN THAT STOPPED AT ABOUT HALF PAST SEVEN, A MAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-FIVE CAME OUT OF A DOOR AT ABOUT TEN PAST EIGHT WITH A SHOPPING BAG THAT HE HAD PUT ON THE CHAIR AT ABOUT HALF PAST SIX, AND THE SEAT OF THE CHAIR WAS WET, AND HE PUT HIS HAND ON THE TOP OF THE BACK OF IT AND LOOKED AT THE SEAT AND DID NOT SIT DOWN, AND THEN HE PICKED THE BAG UP OFF THE SEAT AND PUT IT ON THE FLOOR ABOUT TWO FEET AWAY, STRAIGHTENED IT SO IT WOULD NOT GO OVER, AND WENT BACK INSIDE AND SHUT THE DOOR. THAT IS THE WHOLE OF WHAT HE DID AND IT TOOK HIM ABOUT FOUR SECONDS AND HE DID NOT DO IT FOR THE MAN OF THIRTY-TWO AND HE DID NOT DO IT FOR THE NEXT PERSON TO COME OUT AND HE DID NOT DO IT FOR ANYBODY.**

**THE MAN OF THIRTY-TWO SAW IT AND DID NOT WRITE IT DOWN AND IS NOT GOING TO, AND WHETHER IT WAS THE RIGHT THING IS NOT SAID.** It is a true sentence about a man of seventy-five on a landing in July and there is nowhere in this borough to put it, and saying it was the right thing would be a claim about a stranger's wet chair with no standing behind it, and saying it was a stupid thing would not reach the man of seventy-five.

**AND HERE IS WHAT THE BATCH NOTICED, IN HIS OWN HEAD, ON A LANDING, IN THE RAIN, AND IT WENT NOWHERE AND IT IS NOT GOING ANYWHERE: A THING WITH A SPACE AT THE BOTTOM OF IT FOR A NAME CAN BE REFUSED, AND THAT IS NOT A FLAW, AND A THING WITH NOTHING ON IT CANNOT BE REFUSED AND CANNOT BE REQUIRED EITHER, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE OF WHAT THIS BOROUGH HAS BUILT IN NINE MONTHS, ALL OF IT, AND IT IS CORRECT, AND EVERY PIECE OF IT IS THERE BECAUSE SOMEBODY WORKED THE SAME THING OUT NINE TIMES INDEPENDENTLY AND NONE OF THEM HAS EVER PUT IT IN A SENTENCE THAT ANYBODY ELSE HAS READ. AND THERE ARE TWO OF THE FIRST KIND IN THIS CITY. BOTH OF THEM ARE IN BUILDINGS. HE KNOWS ONE OF THEM AND WAS IN A ROOM WITH IT IN THE SECOND WEEK OF JUNE AND DID NOT READ IT AND WAS NOT ASKED ABOUT IT AND SAID NOTHING, AND THE OTHER PERSON WHO HAS READ IT HAS SAID SO OUT LOUD IN DAYLIGHT AND AGAIN ON A TELEPHONE. HE HAS NOT GOT A NOTE OF THE OTHER ONE, NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS GOT A NOTE OF THE OTHER ONE, THAT IS NOT BECAUSE OF HIM, AND IF HE ASKED THE QUESTION IN A ROOM IN DAYLIGHT FOUR PEOPLE WOULD ANSWER HIM DIFFERENTLY AND NONE OF THEM COULD SAY WHAT IT IS FOR. AND HE IS NOT GOING TO ASK IT, ON A LANDING, AT TEN PAST EIGHT IN THE EVENING, IN THE RAIN, ON HIS OWN, TO A CHAIR.**

## 13. WHAT A CORRECT THING COSTS WHEN IT IS DONE TWICE, AND WHERE THE BILL LANDS — CHAPTER 0173

**ON THURSDAY THE SIXTEENTH OF JULY 2015, IN A SERVICE YARD AND A PORTERS' LOBBY BEHIND A BLOCK OF FLATS IN TIDEGLASS, A MAN OF ABOUT FORTY-TWO WHO FITS WASHING MACHINES ASKED FOR THE YARD TAP FOR AN HOUR, AND A MAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-THREE WHO HOLDS THE KEY TO THE CUPBOARD AND IS THE PORTER OF THAT BLOCK SAID YES IN ABOUT FOUR SECONDS, AND IT WAS CORRECT, AND THERE WAS NO PAPER ON IT, AND THE MACHINE NEEDS ABOUT FORTY LITRES AND THE INSIDE TAPS WERE OFF SINCE A RE-PIPE.**

**THE COST LANDED IN THE SAME ROOM ON THE MAN WHO SAID YES, AND HE WAS NOT ASKED FOR ANYTHING, AND SAYING NO IS A THING YOU DO TO A REQUEST AND NOBODY MADE A REQUEST OF HIM.** The tap is about two feet out from the wall and the hose on the reel does not reach the foot of that stairwell and he did not know that until he had the cupboard open. **So he filled a bucket from the standpipe and carried it up a flight of steps and put it in the machine, and he carried it up four times, in daylight, at ten in the morning, in front of about nine people, and every one of those nine people saw him do it.** A woman of about forty-one with a shopping trolley, a boy of about sixteen who got up off the step, two men at the far end, a woman at a first-floor window, and a man who came out of number four to ask about the riser and did not ask about the riser. **By about the third trip somebody at the far end said *let me take that* and he said no and was right to and did not explain why and the man did not ask again.**

**THE MAN OF ABOUT FORTY-TWO DID NOT HELP HIM AND DID NOT OFFER AND SAID NOTHING ABOUT IT, AND HE IS RIGHT, AND IT IS NOT ON AN INVOICE, AND A MAN WHO FITS WASHING MACHINES FOR A LIVING DOES NOT CARRY BUCKETS UP A STAIRWELL FOR FREE AT TEN IN THE MORNING, AND BOTH OF THOSE ARE CORRECT. HE PUT A TOWEL DOWN ON THE STEP SO THE YARD WOULD NOT BE TRACKED ACROSS, AND THAT TOOK ABOUT TWO SECONDS AND COST HIM NOTHING, AND THE TOWEL IS NOT ON ANYTHING EITHER.**

**AND THE WORDS OF THE CARD: A MAN OF THIRTY-TWO WAS AT THE BACK OF THAT YARD FOR THE WHOLE OF IT AND ASKED NOBODY ANYTHING AND SAID NOTHING AND CARRIED NOTHING. HE HAS GOT A WORD FOR IT. THERE IS A PERSON OF NINETEEN IN THIS BOROUGH WHO HAS A WORD FOR WHAT THAT IS, AND SHE HAD IT IN MAY, AND SHE WAS RIGHT ABOUT IT, AND IT IS HER WORD AND IT IS NOT HIS, AND THE WORD WAS NOT SAID AND WAS NOT NAMED IN THAT YARD. HE HAS GOT IT ONCE AND HE IS NOT GOING TO USE IT AGAIN, AND THAT IS NOT A PRINCIPLE AND NOT A RULE HE SET HIMSELF: THE WORD BELONGS TO A PERSON WHO IS OWED NOTHING AND GOT IT FOR NOTHING, AND SAYING IT WOULD MAKE IT HIS, AND IF IT WERE HIS HE WOULD BE THE MAN WHO NAMED WHAT A PORTER OF SIXTY-THREE DID WITH HIS MORNING, AND HE IS A MAN WHO CARRIED NOTHING, AND THE WORD COSTS THE PERSON WHO CARRIES NOTHING, AND HE CANNOT PAY FOR IT. IT IS A DIFFERENT PERSON, A DIFFERENT STREET AND A DIFFERENT SUMMER FROM THE BILL OF 25 JUNE, AND WHETHER IT IS THE SAME SHAPE IS NOT SAID.**

**NOBODY WAS THANKED AND NOBODY REFUSED TO BE THANKED. NOBODY DIED AND NOBODY WAS RESCUED. NOBODY IS A PRICE AND NOBODY IS ON A LIST AND THERE IS NO WAY IN THIS BOROUGH TO STOP A THING BEING HANDED OVER.**

ALL THREE ARE GONE. 0184 NOW SAYS NOBODY HAS HANDED ONE OVER SINCE THE FIFTEENTH AND THE HOUR BETWEEN SIX AND SEVEN WAS NOT HANDED OVER EITHER; ITS FRAME IS *AND THE REST OF IT, WHICH DID NOT MOVE IN THE TEN DAYS*; AND THE VOLUME'S OWN SENTENCE IS FRAMED AS *AND THE SENTENCE IS THE ONE THAT HAS BEEN TRUE IN THIS BOROUGH SINCE THE SECOND OF JUNE*. THE GATE SENTENCE ITSELF IS THE SHARED FORM AND IS ENTITLED TO BE, AND IT STANDS.**
- **NO HANDOVER WAS STAGED IN THIS BATCH. NO CHAPTER PUT EZRA MBEKI OR TREVOR NUNN IN A ROOM. THE FIFTEENTH REMAINS THE LAST HANDOVER EVER STAGED. THE HOUR BETWEEN SIX AND SEVEN WAS NOT STAGED IN THIS BATCH AND IS NOT TO BE STAGED AGAIN IN THIS VOLUME. THE FINDINGS OF APRIL 2015 ARE FIVE MONTHS OLD AND WERE NOT RE-DERIVED, IMPROVED OR USED AS A DISCOVERY.**
- **NO STAND WAS ADDED TO THE COUNT ON THE WET PAVEMENT. IT IS CLOSED AT EIGHT, THE LAST BEING TWENTY PAST SIX ON SUNDAY 3 MAY 2015. HE WAS FOUR HUNDRED YARDS AWAY FROM A THING TWICE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS AND WALKED TOWARD NEITHER OF THEM, AND THAT IS NOT A STAND AND WAS NOT COUNTED AS ONE.**

A REPainted ROOM IS NOT A REASON, A COOL WEEK IS NOT A REASON, A HOT DAY IS NOT A REASON, A SATURDAY IS NOT A REASON AND A FRIDAY IS NOT A REASON, AND NOBODY IS OBLIGED.** Chapter 0184 states two hundred and forty-seven days and Chapter 0174 stated two hundred and thirty-three, and the two are twelve days apart and both are right.
