## 2. WHAT A LAPSED INSTRUMENT LEAVES, AND THE ONLY WAY THIS BOROUGH FINDS ANYTHING OUT

**ON TUESDAY 17 NOVEMBER 2015 JONAS MERCER WALKED THE BOROUGH FOR FIFTY MINUTES AND IT WAS ALL EXACTLY AS IT HAD BEEN.** Nothing taken down, nothing new put up, no gap anywhere he could put a finger into, the drawing still on the shutter at the top, the shutter at the bottom and the inside wall of the hall, the square in the middle of every one of them still with nothing in it, the river down, and about a quarter of an inch of silt on the pavement at the low end of Peverell Street with the gully outside the third door packed with it, because **a gully at the bottom of a street that floods silts up in a month and nobody in this borough came back with a bar.**

**AND THE MAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-THREE IS NOT CALLED AGAIN, AND HE LOOKS DIFFERENT, AND NOBODY ASKS HIM.** He is the same man and not a second: he came at seven in the morning on 22 August to hold a gate open on his own arm and held it nine hours, was paid the going rate in money, has been called nine times since and has declined none, and held a gate in the dark for about an hour on 12 October. **WHAT JONAS MERCER NOTICED, AND COULD NOT PUT IN A SENTENCE FOR A WEEK, WAS THAT HE HAD HIS COAT OVER HIS ARM AND NOTHING IN HIS HANDS.** He said good morning and nothing else. He is not a man who has been set free and nobody is going to say that he has. He is on nothing, is owed nothing, and is not going to be asked.

**AND THE COUNTER, WHICH IS THE ONLY OBJECT IN THIS ACCOUNT THAT HAS EVER ANSWERED ANYTHING, WAS IN A SCENE FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE THE BATCH BEFORE THIS ONE, AND IT ANSWERED NOTHING, GAVE NO COUNT TO ANYBODY, WAS NOT ASKED ABOUT THE ORDER, AND WAS NOT ASKED ABOUT A LAPSE.** A woman of about sixty-five has been behind it for about nine years and has never been told anything. A man of about twenty-eight, who was in the room over a shop on 30 September and said one sentence about a schedule and a rate, and who was at that counter once in June, came in and said: *I want to know if there's anywhere a person can put the low end of that street.* **THE ANSWER HE GOT, TWICE AND IN THE SAME WORDS, WAS *THERE'S NO FORM FOR THAT*, AND HE SAID *I KNOW*, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE OF THE MEETING, WHICH TOOK ABOUT FOUR MINUTES AND WAS THE ONLY THING THAT HAPPENED ANYWHERE IN TIDEGLASS THAT DAY THAT WAS ABOUT THE LOW END OF PEVERELL STREET.** He had been trying since June to get the bottom of Peverell Street onto any piece of paper that exists in a drawer in this city; there is a drawing on the walls and no bottom of Peverell Street on it, and he knew that, and he came anyway, and he said he wanted to have asked it in a room with somebody in it. **THE ONLY THING HE SAID ABOUT THE OTHER HALF — that since the middle of September there has been no reason on any street in this city for anybody to be asked anything at all, and that he had noticed it the way a man notices a bus that has stopped coming — HE SAID ONCE, TO THE FLOOR, AND HE DID NOT TELL ANYBODY, INCLUDING JONAS MERCER, WHO STOOD AT THE OTHER END OF THE VESTIBULE THE WHOLE TIME AND SAID ONE WORD, WHICH WAS NONE.**

**THE EXACT MOTIF STRING *THERE IS NO FORM IN THIS BOROUGH* IS AT ZERO IN ALL TEN CHAPTERS, MEASURED. THE SHORTER CONSTRUCTION *THERE'S NO FORM FOR THAT* APPEARS TWICE AND BOTH ARE THE SAME LINE SPOKEN BY THE WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-FIVE, WHICH IS WHAT CARD 0206 ASKS FOR, AND THE SENTENCE IS ABOUT A STREET AND NOT ABOUT THE ORDER, AND THE ORDER AND THE IDEA OF A BOROUGH FORM ARE NOT PUT IN ONE SENTENCE ANYWHERE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS. THE DRAWER UNDER THAT COUNTER WAS NOT OPENED, NOT COUNTED, NOT ASKED ABOUT AND IS NOWHERE IN CHAPTERS 205–214, AND THE SENTENCE A WOMAN PUT IN IT ON THE MORNING OF 20 MAY 2015 IS STILL IN IT.**

## 3. THE LETTER, THE BOUNDARY, THE CROSSING, AND HOW ANYBODY KNEW

**ON FRIDAY 20 NOVEMBER 2015 A ONE-PAGE LETTER ARRIVED, POLITE, SIGNED BY ISELIN KROGH, ABOUT FIFTY-ONE, CLERK OF A STANDING GROUP OF THREE AUTHORITIES THAT RUNS THE WATER FOR THREE TOWNS IN RAVENSMERE. ITS SECOND PARAGRAPH THANKED THIS CITY FOR THE ARRANGEMENT OF THE THIRTIETH OF SEPTEMBER AND ITS THIRD INVITED HIM TO SIT IN A ROOM ON THE FOURTH OF DECEMBER. ITS FOURTH PARAGRAPH READS: *WE RECORD YOU AS OUR CORRESPONDENT ON THE ABOVE.* THE WORD IS NOT TRUE AND HE SAID SO BACK ON THE SATURDAY, ON A SHEET OF HIS OWN, IN THE POST, AND HE CAME.**

**THERE IS NO BUDGET FOR IT, THERE IS NOTHING IN THIS BOROUGH HE CAN BOOK A SEAT ON AND NO WAY OF BOOKING ONE ANYWHERE ELSE, AND THERE IS NOTHING IN THIS BOROUGH THAT CAN MAKE HIM BE IN A ROOM IN ANOTHER CITY, AND THE WHOLE OF WHAT THE GROUP HAS IS A MAN WHO HAS GONE.** He said, out loud, before anybody had asked him anything, to three people on Sunday 22 November: **HE IS GOING AS A PERSON WHO IS THERE, AND HE IS NOT ANYBODY'S DELEGATE, AND THE ARRANGEMENT HAS NO WORD FOR THAT.** He said it first to Nell Ardent on the clinic stairs, then to Sanaa Iqbal in a hospital car park, then to Tomas Renn over a cup of tea. **AND RENN'S ANSWER IS THE CARD'S MAJOR TURN AND IT IS NOT IMPROVED BY ANYBODY: IT IS THE FIRST TIME ANYBODY HAS SAID THAT SENTENCE TO HIM BEFORE BEING ASKED, IN NINE MONTHS, HE HAS BEEN ON THE OTHER SIDE OF IT ABOUT NINE TIMES, HE HAS NEVER ONCE BEEN TOLD IN ADVANCE, AND EVERY SINGLE TIME HE HAS GOT IT RIGHT AND EVERY SINGLE TIME IT HAS COST HIM THE WHOLE OF THE EVENING GETTING IT RIGHT ON HIS OWN IN A CORRIDOR FIRST.**

**SANAA IQBAL'S BOUNDARY WAS SAID IN A DOORWAY AT ABOUT HALF PAST SIX IN THE MORNING ON SUNDAY 29 NOVEMBER, IN ADVANCE, ON THE MORNING OF THE BOAT: SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE FIXED, SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE THE REASON ANYBODY IS TALKED OUT OF ANYTHING OR TALKED IN TO ANYTHING, AND IF SHE FINDS OUT IN THREE WEEKS THAT EITHER OF THOSE THINGS HAPPENED SHE WILL BE EXTREMELY UNPLEASANT ABOUT IT AND HE CAN PUT IT IN THE LETTER; AND SHE IS GOING BECAUSE THERE IS A BOAT AT TEN PAST SEVEN AND FOUR OF THEM ARE ON IT AND A ROOM ON THE FRIDAY, AND SHE WOULD HAVE GOT IN THAT BOAT IF THERE HAD BEEN THREE OF THEM AND SHE WOULD HAVE GOT IN IT IF THERE HAD BEEN FIVE, AND THERE IS NOT A SECOND REASON UNDERNEATH IT.** He did not argue with it in a doorway at half past six in the morning. **IT WAS NOT A QUARREL AND NONE OF THE FOUR IMPROVED IT AND THEY ARE NOT REPAIRED AND NOTHING ABOUT THE TWO OF THEM WHO STOPPED ARGUING IN SEPTEMBER IS FIXED IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS, AND THE FACT THAT SHE WAS ON THE BOAT IS A FACT ABOUT THE BOAT AND THE WORK. HER TWENTY MINUTES A WEEK AND THE COMPLIANCE PARAGRAPH BEHIND IT ARE UNTOUCHED AND PARAGRAPH 4.11 IS NOT ANSWERED.**

**THE FOUR OF THEM WERE JONAS MERCER, TOMAS RENN, NELL ARDENT AND SANAA IQBAL AND THEY HAD NOT BEEN IN A ROOM TOGETHER SINCE THE MIDDLE OF SEPTEMBER, WHEN TWO OF THEM ARGUED IN FRONT OF ABOUT THIRTY PEOPLE AND STOPPED AND NEITHER OF THEM DECIDED TO STOP.** Nell Ardent was sick over the side at about a quarter of the way over and said *Don't* and was told *I wasn't going to*. Renn made Jonas tell him about the eleventh of November on the boat. Ardent said she had two questions for the room and a third one she would not be asking, because she has no standing in that room and neither has anybody else on the boat, and said *I would like it minuted that I read it*, and it is not minuted. They landed at about ten past eight at a slip in Ravensmere past a bridge, and a man in a peaked cap told them the works was the second one past the bridge.

**AND THE UNANSWERED THING THIS OPENED: NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH — NOT JONAS MERCER, NOT NELL ARDENT, NOT TOMAS RENN — HAS WORKED OUT HOW A STANDING GROUP OF THREE AUTHORITIES IN ANOTHER CITY HEARD OF A SHEET OF TWO PAGES THAT WENT DOWN ON A COUNTER BY THE WATER IN FRONT OF SIX PEOPLE ON 30 SEPTEMBER 2015 AND WENT BACK ACROSS THE ESTUARY IN A PLASTIC WALLET. NELL ARDENT HAD ALSO BEEN SENT A COPY BY SOMEBODY SHE COULD NOT IDENTIFY AND IS NOT GOING TO TRY. THE PERMISSION FROM ALDERWICK IS THE REASON THAT LETTER EXISTS AND IT IS NOT WORKED OUT, AND IT IS NOT A TWELFTH REFUSAL AND NOT A FINDING AND NOT A SCANDAL, AND IT IS OPEN.**

## 4. THE FIRST REGIONAL SYSTEM, AND THE TWO LINES, AND THE BARGAIN IT REFLECTS

**ON FRIDAY 4 DECEMBER 2015 JONAS MERCER SPENT FOUR HOURS IN THE FIRST OF THE THREE REGIONAL SYSTEMS AND IT IS THE BEST-RUN PUBLIC THING HE HAS EVER STOOD INSIDE.** Ravensmere takes water off an intake, filters it, and delivers it to three towns. The works was built before anybody in that room was born, the filters were renewed some years back and the bill went down when they were, the pressure at the far end of the third town is good enough that the man who runs the clinic there has not had to ask for a tank in nine years, and a standpipe at the edge of the second town costs a person nothing and asks nothing of them. **AND EVERY PART OF IT IS HELD BY SOMEBODY PRIVATELY: IN THE FIRST TOWN THE WORKS IS A COMPANY'S, IN THE SECOND THE MAINS ARE A TRUST'S, IN THE THIRD ONE PUMPING STATION IS MUNICIPAL AND THE OTHER TWO ARE NOT, AND THE TWO THAT ARE NOT HAVE BOTH CHANGED HANDS INSIDE TEN YEARS, AND EVERY TIME ONE CHANGED HANDS NOTHING WAS BROKEN AND NOTHING WAS PROMISED AND THE OBLIGATIONS STAYED EXACTLY WHERE THEY WERE. THE GROUP IS THREE AUTHORITIES AND ABOUT SIX STAFF.**

**NOBODY IN IT IS A VILLAIN AND NOBODY IS HIDING ANYTHING AND EVERY SENTENCE ISELIN KROGH SAYS IS RIGHT.** She said the word *deliberate* out loud. She said nothing in the arrangement asks a person to give anything up. She said nothing about it is secret, and the terms are on the wall, and the office hands a copy to anybody who walks in and asks for one, and there is no charge for it and no record of who has taken one — **AND JONAS MERCER WAS THE ONLY PERSON WHO ASKED FOR ONE IN THREE WEEKS, AND IT IS IN A PLASTIC WALLET IN HIS INSIDE COAT POCKET, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING HE HAS BROUGHT HOME FROM ANOTHER CITY IN THIS ACCOUNT AND IT COST HIM NOTHING.**

**AND THE SHEET IS THE FINDING. IT IS A GOOD SHEET AND IT SAYS THIS, AT THE BOTTOM, IN THE SAME TYPE, THE SAME SIZE, WITH THE SAME SPACE ABOVE EACH:**

> *Nothing is required of any person in order to use any part of this system.*
> *A person has no standing in respect of anything recorded under this.*

**A PERSON IS NOT REQUIRED TO GIVE ANYTHING UP TO USE IT, AND A PERSON CANNOT DO ANYTHING ABOUT WHAT HAPPENS TO WHAT THEY HAVE GIVEN, AND BOTH OF THOSE ARE IN THE SAME TWO LINES. THERE IS NOTHING BETWEEN THEM. THE CORRIDOR SHEET IN RAVENSMERE CARRIES ONLY THE FIRST LINE; THE FULL SHEET IN THE OFFICE CARRIES BOTH; BOTH CARRY THE DATE THE FILTERS WERE DONE IN A FOOTNOTE; AND THE WALL ONE HAS HAD A LINE TAKEN OFF IT AND HAS NOT BEEN LEFT BLANK.**

**AND A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-ONE, WHO COMES TO A CANTEEN HATCH AT TEN TO THREE ON FRIDAYS IN THIS CITY AND IS ON NOTHING AND IS NOT A PARTY TO ANYTHING, PUT THOSE TWO FACTS NEXT TO EACH OTHER IN THAT CORRIDOR AND THEN WISHED HE HAD NOT.** He had crossed on a Friday boat and gone back on a Sunday four times since August and had not told anybody. He said: *That's two lines.* And: *I'd rather I hadn't said that. Not because it's wrong. Because I've just said the only thing anybody's said about that wall in about ten years and I'm in a corridor, and I don't know who heard it, and I can't un-say it, and I'm going to have to go back into that room in twenty minutes and sit down.* He said it, went back in, and said nothing else for the rest of the morning. **HE IS THE SAME MAN AS THE ONE IN 0201 AND 0202 AND IS NOT A SECOND OF HIM AND IS NOT RE-AGED. HE IS NOT A THREAD AND HE IS OWED NOTHING.**

## 5. THE SECOND PART OF THE SAME SYSTEM, AND A PERSON PAID BY TWO PLACES

**ON WEDNESDAY 9 DECEMBER 2015 THERE IS A ROOM ON THE SECOND FLOOR AT RAVENSMERE WITH A TIN ON THE TABLE, AND ON THE SECOND WEDNESDAY OF EVERY MONTH PEOPLE COME INTO IT AND ARE PAID IN ENVELOPES AND INITIAL A CORNER OF A SHEET, AND THE MONEY IS IN THE ENVELOPE BEFORE THE WORK, WHICH IS NOT A FAVOUR AND IS THE CONDITION OF THE WHOLE ARRANGEMENT.**

**A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-NINE IS ONE OF THE NINE NAMES ON THE SCHEDULE OF THE PERMISSION OF 30 SEPTEMBER 2015 — THE LAST NAME ON IT, WHOSE ROW IS A NAME WITH THIS CITY UNDER IT — AND HE WAS NEVER ASKED WHY HE IS NOT ON THE SHEET THAT CAME BACK, AND NOBODY IN THIS CITY HAS ASKED.** He has a job at a pumping station in this city, in Tideglass, four days a week, on the distribution side of the estuary, doing the work of two men. **HE IS BEING PAID BY A CITY ACROSS THE WATER, IN AN ENVELOPE, AT THAT CITY'S RATE, WHICH IS NOT THE RATE THE SAME WORK IS PAID AT ON HIS SIDE OF THE WATER, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS NOT SMALL, AND HE CROSSES THE ESTUARY ON THE PAY DAY TO BE PAID, AND HE HAS DONE IT FOUR TIMES SINCE SEPTEMBER AND WILL DO IT IN JANUARY.**

**BOTH CITIES CALL IT SOMETHING DIFFERENT AND HE IS THE ONLY PERSON IN THE WORLD WHO KNOWS THE DIFFERENCE.** The water undertaker in this city calls it a **relief contract**. Ravensmere's sheet calls it an **attachment**, and defines an attached man as a man attached to the works. **NOBODY IN THIS CITY COULD PRODUCE EITHER PIECE OF WRITING EVEN IF THEY WERE ASKED, BECAUSE THE PERMISSION IS IN A PLASTIC WALLET IN A CITY ON THE OTHER SIDE OF AN ESTUARY AND THE ATTACHMENT SHEET IS IN A CORRIDOR IN ANOTHER CITY, AND WHAT HE HAS IS A NAME ON A SHEET IN EACH PLACE.** He said, to nobody in particular, that he has got a house and a road and a bed about two miles from where he stood at seven o'clock that morning and is attached to a works on the other side of an estuary that he has never once been asked inside.

**JONAS MERCER STOOD IN THE CORRIDOR, COULD HAVE ASKED HIM ONE QUESTION, AND DID NOT. HE IS THE ONLY PERSON IN EITHER CITY WHO COULD HAVE, BECAUSE HE IS THE ONLY PERSON WHO HAS READ BOTH OF THE TWO WORDS. HE IS NOT GOING TO. THE ARRANGEMENT IS IN WRITING AND THE WRITING IS CORRECT. THE ENVELOPE WAS STILL SEALED WHEN THE MAN WENT DOWN IN THE LIFT AT ABOUT FOUR O'CLOCK AND THEY DID NOT EXCHANGE ANOTHER WORD.**

**AND THE GROUP'S OWN AFTERNOON ITEM ON THE NINTH, WHICH HE WAS IN THE CORRIDOR FOR AND DID NOT HEAR, WAS TWO DOCUMENTS BOTH CORRECT AND BOTH TAKEN FROM THAT PERMISSION: THE NUMBER OF PEOPLE THE ARRANGEMENT HAD MOVED, WHICH IS SIX, AND THE SIX DATES ON A SHEET IN A DUTY CLERK'S BAG; AND THE SENTENCE ABOUT WHERE A CLAIM ARISING OUT OF THE WORK IS MADE, WHICH ISELIN KROGH READ OUT IN THE VOICE SHE USES FOR THINGS THAT ARE ALREADY SETTLED, AND NOBODY ARGUED WITH IT, AND THE MINUTE SAYS THE ITEM WAS NOTED. A PRICED-ACCESS CASE IS NOT A RECOGNITION CASE. A DUTY IS AN ACT AND NOT A PLACE AND MAY NOT BECOME A WAY OF MAKING A STREET FINDABLE. A PERSON WHO IS NOT COUNTED IS NOT A PERSON WHO IS HELPED AND NOTHING IN THIS BATCH REFUTED THAT.**

## 6. THE CORRIDOR, AND THE SENTENCE, AND ITS STANDING

**ON TUESDAY 15 DECEMBER 2015, AFTER AN HOUR OF ORDINARY ARGUMENT ABOUT STANDPIPE HOURS THAT SETTLED ON SEVEN IN THE MORNING TO EIGHT IN THE EVENING — WHICH IS NOBODY'S NUMBER — ISELIN KROGH CAME OUT OF THE ROOM AND SAID THE TRUE THING ABOUT THE BARGAIN INTO A CORRIDOR, TO ONE PERSON, COULD NOT FINISH THE SENTENCE, SAID IT ANYWAY, AND THEN SAID SHE SHOULD NOT HAVE SAID IT, AND IT WAS NOT TAKEN BACK.**

**WHAT SHE SAID, IN THE FORM 0211 GIVES IT, IS THE CANON OF THE FIRST REGIONAL SYSTEM AND IT MAY NOT BE SOFTENED:** it is not a bargain between two things; it is an agreement between three of them and a great many people outside that building that the part everybody is responsible for will always be the part somebody owns; the obligations were written first, the ownership came afterwards in pieces over a generation in rooms she was not in; nobody has had to do anything wrong for any of that to happen, and nobody in that room has done anything wrong, and every part fits, and the water is good, and the standpipe runs, and the filters were done on time — **and the result of it, which nobody has ever put in a sentence in that room, is that the whole of the part of this that three towns are answerable for is the part that nobody owns, and the part nobody owns is the part that gets sold.** She could not finish it because the next part of that sentence is the part she cannot say, and because in that room the sentence is an accusation and it is not an accusation and there is no way of putting it in that room that it does not come out as one, and she has been in that building nineteen years and has stopped looking for a way round it.

**SHE SAID IT BECAUSE THE MAN SHE SAID IT TO HAS NO STANDING, NO OFFICE, NO DEPARTMENT AND NO BODY BEHIND HIM, AND SHE SAID THAT OUT LOUD. JONAS MERCER SAID NOTHING AT ALL, AND THE NOTEBOOK IN THE INSIDE POCKET OF HIS COAT STAYED IN THE INSIDE POCKET OF HIS COAT, AND ON THE FRIDAY MORNING NELL ARDENT SAID *YOU'VE BEEN IN THAT BUILDING TWICE. WHAT IS WRONG WITH IT* AND HE SAID *NOTHING'S WRONG WITH IT. THE WATER'S GOOD*, AND SHE LOOKED AT HIM FOR SLIGHTLY TOO LONG AND WENT BACK TO HER PAPER, AND IT STAYED IN THE CORRIDOR WHERE SHE PUT IT.**

**THE STANDING OF THAT SENTENCE IN THIS ACCOUNT IS EXACTLY THE STANDING OF A SENTENCE SAID ONCE ON A PAVEMENT IN SEPTEMBER: IT WAS SAID ONCE, IT IS NOT WRITTEN DOWN, IT IS NOT REPEATED, IT IS NOT MINUTED, IT IS NOT IN A REPORT, IT IS NOT IN ANY OF THE STATE FILES AS A THING ANYBODY DID, AND IT IS CARRIED AS A THING THAT HAPPENED TO A PERSON AND NOT AS A PARAGRAPH.** Nobody was given authority and nobody's sentence improved.

## 7. AN ORDINARY DAY, AND THE THIRD TIME

**ON SUNDAY 20 DECEMBER 2015, IN A CITY THAT IS NOT THIS ONE, WITH NOTHING IN THE REGIONAL SYSTEM HAVING ANYTHING TO DO WITH HIM AND NOBODY HAVING ARRANGED THAT IT WOULD, TWO SMALL CORRECT THINGS HAPPENED ON ONE AFTERNOON, AND NEITHER PERSON WAS ON ANYTHING, AND NOBODY FOUND OUT, AND THE ONLY PERSON WHO KNOWS BOTH OF THEM HAPPENED IS THE PERSON WHO WALKED DOWN THE SAME STREET TWICE.**

- **THE FIRST, AT ABOUT TWENTY PAST TWO, IN A QUEUE OUTSIDE A CHEMIST'S: A MAN OF ABOUT EIGHTY-FOUR, THIRD FROM THE FRONT, WITH A BASKET, WAS RIGHT ABOUT A BAD LABEL.** The window showed a smaller bottle at ninety-one pence and the shelf a larger one at a pound four; he was wrong about the bottle and right about the label, said *put a card on the big one*, was told the shop does not do cards on a Sunday, said *then do it on a Monday and do it before anybody's paid*, and was told *I'll put a label in, I can't do a card*, to which he said *a label's a card with a price on it*. He took the small bottle for the small money. **THE CHEMIST WROTE A NOTE ON THE BACK OF HER HAND AND PUT THE BOTTLE SOMEWHERE ELSE ON THE SHELF, WHICH IS A SYSTEM, AND IT IS THE WHOLE OF THE SYSTEM, AND A LABEL WENT IN ON THE MONDAY MORNING AT ABOUT TEN PAST NINE AND IT SAYS THE SAME AS THE WINDOW.**
- **THE SECOND, SMALLER, AT ABOUT TEN TO THREE, FOUR HUNDRED YARDS UP THE SAME STREET, AT A BUS SHELTER: A WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-NINE WAS RIGHT ABOUT A TIMETABLE.** The four o'clock bus comes at ten to, has done since the Sunday service was changed, and nobody reprinted the timetable, and the board in the shelter and the sheet in a shop in the third town are not even out of the same year. **The driver has known since the change, does not say, and looks in the mirror once at about the second stop. She is not going to stand in a shelter and shout at a bus driver about a printed sheet on a Sunday, and the four o'clock is at ten to until somebody who owns the printing says different, and she has not got an idea who that is and neither has Jonas Mercer.**

**THEY WERE FOUR HUNDRED YARDS APART AND NEITHER KNEW ANYTHING ABOUT THE OTHER, AND HE TOLD NEITHER OF THEM ANYTHING.** **AND THIS IS THE THIRD TIME SINCE THE PUMP AT THE BOTTOM OF PEVERELL STREET THAT A CORRECT THING HAS BEEN DONE IN A STREET BY SOMEBODY WHO IS ON NOTHING AND NOTHING HAS COME OF IT, THE FIRST BEING A DOORWAY KEPT DRY WITH A PUMP BY A MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-SEVEN IN SEPTEMBER, THE SECOND BEING A GULLY CLEARED WITH A BAR BY A MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-FOUR AND A WOMAN OF ABOUT EIGHTY-FIVE ON 10 NOVEMBER, AND THE THIRD BEING THESE TWO, AND 0212 NAMES THE FIRST TWO IN ITS OWN HEAD SO THAT THE COUNT IS TRUE ON THE PAGE AND NOT ONLY HERE.** **THE THREE ARE DONE BY THREE SEPARATE SETS OF PEOPLE AND A REVIEW CAUGHT ONE STATE FILE MERGING THE SECOND INTO THE FIRST; THE PUMP AND THE DOORWAY BELONG TO THE MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-SEVEN AND THE GULLY AND THE BAR BELONG TO THE MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-FOUR AND THE WOMAN OF ABOUT EIGHTY-FIVE, AND NEITHER MAY BE ATTRIBUTED TO THE OTHER.**

## 8. THE CLAIM THAT CAME BACK, AND THE TWO OF THEM IN TWO CITIES

**ON SATURDAY 26 DECEMBER 2015, ON A SIGNED-FOR BUNDLE AT A RECORDS DESK IN A BUILDING BY THE WATER IN THIS CITY, A CLAIM ARRIVED. IT IS CORRECT. IT ARRIVED IN AN ORDINARY WAY. IT IS ABOUT MONEY. AND THE CLAUSE THAT SENT IT IS THE SIXTH.**

- It is one sheet, dated **11 December 2015**, carrying the same reference as the permission, headed as a claim made under the mutual-aid permission of the thirtieth of September 2015 and made in the city in which the work was done. It is addressed to the water office, which is two floors up and had gone for Christmas.
- It names **one man, who is about twenty**, and says he was employed for **fourteen days in October** under that permission at a pumping station on the north bank at **Alderwick**, and that on the last day of that fortnight he was injured, and that the injury is described in two lines, and that a sum is claimed. The sum is not large. It is about what a man of that age costs to keep for about a month.
- **THE SIXTH CLAUSE SAYS A CLAIM ARISING OUT OF WORK DONE UNDER THE PERMISSION IS MADE IN THE CITY WHERE THE WORK WAS DONE AND NOT IN THE CITY THE PERSON CAME FROM. THE CLAIM IS MADE IN ALDERWICK. THE CLAIM IS CORRECTLY MADE. IT HAS COME TO TIDEGLASS, WHICH IS THE CITY THAT GRANTED THE PERMISSION AND THE CITY THE PERSON CAME FROM, AND IT CANNOT BE DEALT WITH HERE.**
- It went into a tray under a window on Nina Calder's desk, which is a tray and is not a register, and it will be picked up on the Monday by whoever signs for the water office and will go into a pile, and the pile is not anywhere anybody looks, and the woman from the water office could come down and take it upstairs herself and do something perfectly good with it, and there is no way of telling Jonas Mercer which of those two will happen and that is why he can only say *put it in the tray*.

**AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH CAN TELL WHETHER IT IS A PRICE, A RECEIPT OR A PRECEDENT, AND ALL THREE READINGS ARE TRUE AND ARE NOT THE SAME SHAPE.** A price, because the first thing to come back along a piece of paper to a city that handed something out for nothing is a bill. A receipt, because six people in this city took fourteen days across the estuary in October, were paid in an envelope before the work, all six came home on the dates on a sheet, one of the six has since had a claim made about him, and there is nothing in this borough that could tell those two things apart. A precedent, because it is the first one, and it asks the authority that granted the permission for the sum, and if this borough answers it then it has agreed that the permission runs backwards as well as forwards, and if it does not answer it then a man of about twenty who worked a fortnight at a pumping station and came home has not got anybody. **AND THE BOROUGH HAS NO INSTRUMENT FOR CHOOSING, BECAUSE A BODY THAT CANNOT REQUIRE ANYBODY TO DO ANYTHING CANNOT BE TOLD WHAT IT WILL DO, AND BECAUSE THE TWO PEOPLE WITH A DEPARTMENT ARE NOT GOING TO WRITE ANYTHING DOWN THIS CHRISTMAS, AND BECAUSE THE WOMAN IN ANOTHER CITY HAS ONE OF HER OWN AND IS NOT GOING TO BE ASKED BY ANYBODY TO PUT HERS NEXT TO THIS ONE.**

**JONAS MERCER WAS THE FIRST PERSON TO SEE WHAT IT WAS AND HE DID NOT SAY SO AND HE DID NOT GO AND FIND THE MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY, WHO WAS AT A FOOTBALL MATCH IN THIS CITY THAT AFTERNOON WITH ABOUT EIGHT HUNDRED OTHER PEOPLE. THAT AFTERNOON HE TELEPHONED RAVENSMERE AND ISELIN KROGH SAID, BEFORE HE HAD GOT TO ANYTHING, THAT SHE HAD HAD A LETTER WITH THE SAME REFERENCE ON IT ON THE EIGHTEENTH AND HAD PUT IT IN A FOLDER IN A DRAWER; HE ASKED HER WHAT IT WAS; SHE SAID *I AM NOT GOING TO SAY THAT ON A TELEPHONE* AND HE SAID HE HAD A LETTER AS WELL. NEITHER OF THEM SAID WHAT EITHER OF THEM HAD. BY THE TIME SOMEBODY ELSE KNEW WHAT IT WAS THERE WERE TWO OF THEM IN TWO CITIES, AND THERE IS NO DOCUMENT IN EITHER OF THOSE TWO CITIES THAT SAYS THAT EITHER OF THEM KNEW.**

**THE MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-SEVEN IS NOT THE MAN THIS IS ABOUT. HE DOES NOT APPEAR IN 0213 AT ALL AND MAY NOT BE PUT IN ONE SENTENCE, ONE LIST OR ONE ROOM WITH THE MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY OR WITH Ewen Ashgrove, WHO ALSO APPEARS NOWHERE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS.**

## 9. THE LAST EVENING, AND THE TWO DOCUMENTS, AND WHAT IS STILL OPEN

**ON WEDNESDAY 30 DECEMBER 2015 AT ABOUT SEVEN IN THE EVENING, IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP IN RAVENSMERE, WITH JONAS MERCER, NELL ARDENT AND SANAA IQBAL, THE BATCH'S QUESTION WAS RESTATED AS A FACT ABOUT TWO PIECES OF PAPER HELD IN TWO HANDS AND IT WAS NOT ANSWERED AND IT IS NOT ANSWERED NOW.**

- **In Jonas Mercer's hand, in a plastic wallet:** the full sheet from the works office, given to him on 4 December, no charge, no record of who has taken one.
- **In Nell Ardent's hand:** two sheets in her own writing, the first copied off the corridor wall sheet, the second off the office sheet, compared with a ruler, on the same table, with the group's printed agenda for 4 December beside them and a fourth sheet empty.
- **The wall sheet carries one line. The office sheet carries two. The second line on the office sheet is *A person has no standing in respect of anything recorded under this.* The short sheet has not been left blank, it has had a line taken off it, and the four inches underneath are white and they are not white because there was nothing there.**

**THAT IS THE BATCH'S QUESTION AS A FACT ABOUT TWO DOCUMENTS AND NOBODY ANSWERS IT: A PERMISSION IS A THING A PERSON MAY DO AND AN OBLIGATION IS A THING A PERSON HAS TO DO, AND EVERY ONE OF THE WORDS ON BOTH SHEETS IS A PERMISSION, AND ON THE SAME SHEET, IN THE SAME TYPE, IT SAYS THAT WHATEVER THE WATER MADE A NOTE OF IS NOT YOURS TO HAVE A SAY ABOUT; THOSE ARE NOT TWO DIFFERENT SYSTEMS, THAT IS ONE SYSTEM WITH A FRONT DOOR AND NO BACK, AND NOBODY IN EITHER CITY CAN SAY WHICH OF THE TWO THE PEOPLE WERE HANDED.** Nell Ardent said she has looked and has not got an answer and is not going to make one up in a room above a shop on the thirtieth of December, and that if she did it would be the first thing anybody had said in nine months about any of this that was not true. Jonas Mercer said the answer is on the second sheet. Nell Ardent said the answer is on the second sheet, and the sheet with both lines on it is in an office in a building that owns a works and is not in any building in this borough, and the short one is on a wall about two hundred people a day go past without reading, and he is the only person who has asked.
